steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure a reverse price-based auction awarded as one lot.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Set the first line item's delivery location.

args.goal: On the single-stage create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the configured terms visible or saved.

steps.note: Configure the event-wise clauses and their required/optional modes, which have no dedicated domain step.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the immediate 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Attempt submission with the required clause still unchecked; the bid must be refused.
Confirm the required clause remains identified on the vendor screen after the blocked submission.
Accept the required clause after the refusal.
Submit the bid at 100 after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted and submitted.
